description: Xing Jobs Collector — collects job postings (title, description, apply URL) from Xing search results (Full Remote, posted in the last 7 days via the UI date filter) and POSTs them to a webhook as {collection, query, items}. Runs in popup execution context (no 5-minute runtime cap) — recommended for max_jobs > 50; background mode is OK for max_jobs <= 50. Dismisses the cookie-consent dialog and applies the date filter via UI clicks with EN/DE label handling.
